_comment: Findings recorded by the lead during acquisition that are not attached to a single
record's gates.json. These are places where the work order and the retrieved
sources disagree, or where the work order pointed at something that is not a
primary record. The retrieved source always wins; this file is the audit trail.

findings.source_says: That URL is an FDA press announcement, not a regulatory record. The primary records for this decision are BLA 761269 supplement 1: the approval letter, the multidisciplinary review, and the approved label.
findings.detail: The hard rules forbid substituting a press release for a primary record that exists. Located the actual documents through the Drugs@FDA API (api.fda.gov/drug/drugsfda.json) and added them as targets fda-leqembi-approval-letter-traditional, fda-leqembi-review-traditional, fda-leqembi-label-traditional and fda-leqembi-summary-review-accelerated. The press announcement is retained only as a dated regulatory-communication object, never as the evidence for what FDA concluded.

findings.source_says: Also a press announcement. The primary record is the 510(k) decision summary for K242706 in the FDA device database.
findings.detail: Same substitution rule as the Leqembi entry. The 510(k) record and the releasable decision documents are the evidence for what was cleared and on what data; the press announcement is a communication about it.

findings.source_says: An advocacy-organisation news item reporting a conference presentation.
findings.detail: Not a primary record. Acquisition fell back to the registry record and any peer-reviewed publication; the news item is not ingested as evidence for the trial's results.

findings.source_says: ResearchGate is not a legal open-access route and is excluded by the acquisition rules.
findings.detail: Identity was resolved through Europe PMC and Crossref instead, and full text acquired through a permitted route.

findings.work_order_says: PMC10979350 for the Ashton et al. ALZpath p-tau217 diagnostic-accuracy paper
findings.source_says: PMC10979350 resolves to a different article, and the identifier collides with the Hansson et al. blood-biomarker review target in the same work order.
findings.detail: Two work-order rows resolved to the same record through the supplied identifiers. Flagged as a weak-title-match and queued for agent re-resolution so the two papers are not merged into one corpus record.
